newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Dollar sinks to four-month low in early Asia.
newsitem.headline: Dollar sinks to four-month low in early Asia.

text.p: The dollar sank to a fresh four month low in heavy Asian trading as Japanese investors bailed out of long positions.

Dealers said sell orders from Tokyo were piling up and fundamentals were being ignored in a panic to get out of huge U.S. dollar positions as investors feared the yen's two-year-old donwtrend had finally turned.

By 8.45 am (2245 GMT) the dollar had dived to 118.55/65 yen from 120.20/30 late in New York Friday, breaking Friday's intraday low of 119.10 in the process. It was steadier on the mark at 1.6840/50 from 1.6875/85.
